items.title: VeriSign (VRSN) Will Launch The .Web Domain
items.summary: VeriSign (NasdaqGS: VRSN) plans to launch the .web top-level domain after securing ICANN approval following a prolonged dispute. The .web extension will be introduced through a phased rollout, expanding VeriSign's domain portfolio beyond its existing .com and .net offerings. Management describes .web as a major new addition to its registry portfolio that is expected to reshape the firm's product mix over time.
